zh.title: 中國商飛CE-25A電動飛機完成首次載人試飛　19座設計邁入下一階段
zh.summary: 中國商飛CE-25A於11月14日在山東濱州完成首次載人試飛，機上有2名飛行員與1名試飛工程師，先前已完成19次無人飛行驗證。
body: 中國商飛（COMAC）研發的CE-25A全電動飛機於2026年11月14日在山東省濱州完成首次載人試飛。根據中國民用航空局發布的消息，飛機搭載兩名飛行員與一名試飛工程師，試飛過程中各系統運作正常，性能指標達到預期。這項進展代表CE-25A正式進入載人試驗階段，但距離取得適航認證及投入商業服務仍有後續程序。
航空媒體AeroTime報導，CE-25A此次在空中飛行16分38秒、航程60.4公里；連同地面作業的完整測試歷時57分46秒。自今年2月2日首次無人自主飛行以來，該機已進行19次無人飛行驗證。其設計採用分布式電動涵道風扇推進，公布規格包含最多19個乘客座位、最大起飛重量10公噸、每小時300公里巡航速度，以及約400公里航程。
CE-25A由中國商飛與寧德時代、上海交通大學等合作開發。中國民航局表示已受理這款飛機的型號合格證申請；這代表審定程序已有進展，但不等於完成核准。SKYTICAL在10月底曾報導CE-25A機身照片引起討論，這次正式公布的載人試飛，讓外界得以進一步確認專案進度。本文配圖為CE-25A創作示意圖，並非試飛現場照片。

en.title: COMAC CE-25A makes first piloted test flight as electric commuter project advances
en.summary: COMAC's CE-25A completed its first piloted flight on November 14 in Shandong with two pilots and a flight-test engineer, following 19 unmanned validation flights.
body: COMAC's CE-25A electric commuter aircraft completed its first piloted test flight at Binzhou in Shandong province on November 14, 2026. According to a report published by the Civil Aviation Administration of China, two pilots and a flight-test engineer were aboard. COMAC said the aircraft's systems operated normally and test indicators met expectations. A successful piloted test does not constitute type certification or approval for commercial passenger service.

AeroTime reported 16 minutes and 38 seconds of airborne time covering 60.4 kilometers, with the full test activity lasting 57 minutes and 46 seconds. The programme previously completed 19 unmanned validation flights, starting on February 2. The aircraft is designed around distributed electric ducted fans and is intended to carry up to 19 passengers, with a published maximum takeoff weight of 10 tonnes, cruise speed of 300 km/h and range of around 400 kilometers.

COMAC is developing the type with partners including CATL and Shanghai Jiao Tong University. China's aviation authority has accepted an application for a type certificate, but certification work is ongoing. Earlier unverified images of a CE-25A prototype had prompted debate about the programme's status; the confirmed flight provides a stronger milestone. The accompanying CC0 illustration is not a photo of the November 14 flight.

facts.claim: COMAC's CE-25A first flew with two pilots and a flight-test engineer on November 14, 2026 in Binzhou, Shandong.
CE-25A is designed for up to 19 passengers at a maximum takeoff weight of 10 tonnes, cruise 300 km/h, range 400 km.
The test flew for 16 minutes 38 seconds covering 60.4 km; it followed 19 unmanned validation flights.
CAAC accepted a type certificate application but the aircraft has not been certified.
